title: Very small font on the message count and weather badges
line: The temperature shown over the Weather widget's icon grows with the icon again instead of staying tiny on wide or tall panels.
explanation: In 6.6 BadgeOverlay sized its text to a quarter of the icon height when given an icon. Since its port to Kirigami.Badge (plasma-workspace 41b938d00d) it always uses the small font minus one point, so the Weather widget's temperature badge stays tiny on big icons, e.g. in the reporter's 94 px vertical panel. The weather applet now sets the badge font to a quarter of the icon height again (in points), never smaller than the old default, so small panels and the system tray look the same as before.

commits.message:
applets/weather: scale the temperature badge with the icon

BadgeOverlay got a fixed small font when it moved to Kirigami.Badge, so
the temperature shown over the icon became tiny on wide or tall panels.
Size its font to a quarter of the icon height again, as before 6.7.

CCBUG: 521854

patches.diff:
From f64d174114caad9f7665b2a2be37c07055385a98 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 01:47:44 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/weather: scale the temperature badge with the icon

BadgeOverlay got a fixed small font when it moved to Kirigami.Badge, so
the temperature shown over the icon became tiny on wide or tall panels.
Size its font to a quarter of the icon height again, as before 6.7.

CCBUG: 521854
---
 applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml | 3 +++
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
index c66ae91a7..beb320722 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -74,6 +74,9 @@ Loader {
 
                 text: compactRoot.isTemperaturePresent ? Util.temperatureToDisplayString(compactRoot.displayTemperatureUnit, compactRoot.lastObservation.temperature, compactRoot.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, false) : "";
                 icon: parent
+                // Scale the text with the icon (a quarter of its height, in points)
+                // so the temperature stays readable on big icons
+                font.pointSize: Math.max(Kirigami.Theme.smallFont.pointSize - 1, Math.round(weatherIcon.height * 0.75 / 4))
 
                 // Non-default state to center if the badge is wider than the icon
                 states: [
-- 
2.53.0

With the fix: the badge text scales with the icon, as in 6.6
With the fix, same panel: unchanged (small icons keep the default badge size)
